readme: Gate & rules options (plugin-settings@1): the plugin's own settings (GET / PUT settings) in plugin.json settings.options, read and set through server/plugin_options.py with the gate's own validation. Rules, build rules and the auto-lander (on / off, pause, mode, land) are deliberately not options: they are decisions made on the Gate & rules screen and through its own commands, never a settings write.

settings.label: Refresh every (seconds)
settings.description: How often the open tab asks the lander again.

settings.label: History size (entries kept)
settings.description: The oldest entries go once History holds more than this.
